_about: Built by python -m secondstay.la_costs from LADBS building permits; see that module.

units.kitchen.measures: LADBS building permits, declared job value (apartment kitchen work, per kitchen)
units.kitchen.confidence: LA permit records; declared values tend to run below final cost
units.kitchen.notes: LADBS building permits, declared job value (apartment kitchen work, per kitchen). 25th percentile / median / 75th percentile of 231 LA permits issued 2020-09-02 to 2026-11-04, each value divided by its stated quantity (implausible per-unit values from misread quantities dropped). Permits were read and labelled by a language model; new buildings, revisions and other work were left out.
units.kitchen.excludes: Work on existing apartment kitchens; a new kitchen in former office space also needs supply and drain runs to a riser.

units.fitout.measures: LADBS building permits, declared job value (interior work in existing LA commercial spaces, per sq ft)
units.fitout.confidence: LA permit records; declared values tend to run below final cost
units.fitout.notes: LADBS building permits, declared job value (interior work in existing LA commercial spaces, per sq ft). 25th percentile / median / 75th percentile of 521 LA permits issued 2022-05-25 to 2026-11-03, each value divided by its stated quantity (implausible per-unit values from misread quantities dropped). published.measures: Developer target average for its LA office-to-housing conversions, including Sky Castle (512 homes, 350 S. Figueroa)
published.note: A portfolio target, not one building's cost. The Sky Castle building permit declared about $60 million for 512 homes, about $117,000 each: declared permit values run well below project cost.
